name: Breakfast with Santa at Brighton Recreation Center
when_note: Saturday, December 12, 2026, two seatings: 9 to 10 AM and 10:30 to 11:30 AM
paras: The City of Brighton Recreation Center hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, with two one-hour seatings at 9 AM and 10:30 AM. The city registration page lists 125 spots per seating, so families pick a time when they sign up.

Registration is $10 per person for each session and is handled through the City of Brighton store. Bring the kids for breakfast and a visit with Santa, and sign up early because spots are limited to the 125 per seating.
tip: Choose the 9 AM seating for younger children, since it comes before naps and the later rush.

name: Superior Winter Festival
venue: Downtown Superior, Main Street and Superior Drive
address: Main St & Superior Dr, Superior, CO 80027
when_note: Saturday, December 12, 2026, 2 to 5 PM, tree lighting at 5 PM
cost: Free to attend, some activities may cost extra
paras: The Superior Chamber of Commerce, the Town of Superior and Blue Sport Stable run the Superior Winter Festival in downtown Superior on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 2 to 5 PM. Kids can meet Santa for a keepsake photo, meet the Grinch, see reindeer and ride a hayride around downtown.

The afternoon also offers an Elf Express letter station, face painting, S'mores kits at fire pits, a hot cocoa bar and live performances. Skate with Santa runs 3 to 5 PM at Blue Sport Stable, and the Superior Community Tree lights up at 5 PM.
tip: Arrive near 2 PM for the shortest Santa line, and stay for the 5 PM tree lighting.

name: Timnath Holiday Festival
paras: The Town of Timnath kicks off the season with its Holiday Festival at Timnath Community Park on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 11 AM to 1 PM. Families can visit Santa for photos, make crafts, see ice sculptures and meet holiday characters and reindeer.

Local bands and school choirs perform, and hot drinks and cookies are served. Food trucks and an artisan market are on site, and volunteer golf carts shuttle guests from drop-off points on River Pass Road and Twin Bridge Road.
tip: Park in the neighborhood and use the free golf cart shuttle, since parking near the park fills early.
